capabilities: Capture quick thoughts as daily-note bullets or via phone shortcuts
Classify past captures into flat atomic notes via the Anthropic API
Generate titles, tags, and reason-bearing links between atoms
Resurface filed atoms on a mobile home view
Mirror atoms to a cloud copy so Claude or ChatGPT can search them
extras: Freemium: the plugin code is MIT and free, but filing always costs money — either an Anthropic API key you pay for directly or an Atoms Plus subscription (pricing and free trial at tryatoms.app). Previously named obsidian-ai-linker. Each classify run sends note titles, tags, person-hub titles, and capture text to the Anthropic API over TLS; API keys are stored in SecretStorage, not data.json. Automatic filing is off by default and requires a one-time privacy acknowledgment.
problem: Capturing thoughts as daily-note bullets leaves them unfiled and unlinked; Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically classify past captures into a linked note library.

relations.evidence: Classify past daily-note captures into linked atomic notes via the Anthropic API.
keeps a cloud copy of Atoms/ current while Obsidian is open, so Claude and ChatGPT can ask
Android: install Atoms Capture from Play, or open Settings → Atoms → 1 · Capture

summary: AI classifier that turns past daily-note bullet captures into flat, linked atomic notes filed under Atoms/ and resurfaces them for later expansion.
